scope: West Texas (Midland, Ector, Tom Green, Taylor counties; Midland, Odessa, San Angelo, Abilene) - healthcare, mental health, childcare, employment, legal, plus related local food, utility, housing, transit resources

records.name: PermiaCare 24-Hour Crisis Hotline
records.description_en: A 24-hour phone line for people in a mental health or substance use crisis. PermiaCare is the local mental health authority for Midland and Ector counties.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica abierta las 24 horas para personas en crisis de salud mental o por uso de drogas o alcohol. PermiaCare es la autoridad local de salud mental para los condados de Midland y Ector.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Midland or Ector County (and other PermiaCare counties) who is in crisis or worried about someone.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en los condados de Midland, Ector u otros condados de PermiaCare que esté en crisis o que esté preocupada por alguien.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis hotline any time, day or night.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora, de día o de noche.
records.notes: Toll-free 24-hour line (permiacare.org and locations page). PermiaCare serves Midland, Ector, Brewster, Pecos, Culberson, Hudspeth, Jeff Davis, and Presidio counties. For life-threatening emergencies call 911; 988 is also available.

records.name: PermiaCare Mental Health Services and Clinic - Midland
records.description_en: Outpatient mental health care such as counseling, psychiatric care, and medicine help for adults and children in Midland.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental para adultos y niños en Midland, como consejería, atención psiquiátrica y ayuda con medicinas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in Midland County who need mental health care. PermiaCare has a charity care program with free or discounted care for people who are uninsured, underinsured, or cannot pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en el condado de Midland que necesitan atención de salud mental. PermiaCare tiene un programa de ayuda con cuidado gratis o con descuento para personas sin seguro, con poco seguro o que no pueden pagar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Midland clinic or the PermiaCare line at (844) 420-3964 to ask about getting started.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de Midland o a la línea de PermiaCare al (844) 420-3964 para preguntar cómo empezar.
records.hours: Mon-Thurs 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
records.cost: Charity care available for those unable to pay; ask about fees
records.notes: Charity care policy: https://www.permiacare.org/51358-2/ (questions: humanresources@permiacare.org). County residency rules are not stated on the source; ask when you call.

records.name: PermiaCare Mental Health Services and Clinic - Odessa
records.description_en: Outpatient mental health care such as counseling, psychiatric care, and medicine help for adults and children in Odessa.
records.description_es: Atención de salud mental para adultos y niños en Odessa, como consejería, atención psiquiátrica y ayuda con medicinas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in Ector County who need mental health care. PermiaCare has a charity care program with free or discounted care for people who are uninsured, underinsured, or cannot pay.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en el condado de Ector que necesitan atención de salud mental. PermiaCare tiene un programa de ayuda con cuidado gratis o con descuento para personas sin seguro, con poco seguro o que no pueden pagar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Odessa clinic or the PermiaCare line at (844) 420-3964 to ask about getting started.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica de Odessa o a la línea de PermiaCare al (844) 420-3964 para preguntar cómo empezar.
records.hours: Mon-Thurs 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM
records.cost: Charity care available for those unable to pay; ask about fees
records.notes: Charity care policy: https://www.permiacare.org/51358-2/ (questions: humanresources@permiacare.org). County residency rules are not stated on the source; ask when you call.

records.name: PermiaCare Substance Use Disorder Services
records.description_en: Treatment services for drug and alcohol use, with offices in Midland and Odessa.
records.description_es: Servicios de tratamiento para el uso de drogas y alcohol, con oficinas en Midland y Odessa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in Midland and Ector counties who want help with substance use.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en los condados de Midland y Ector que quieren ayuda con el uso de drogas o alcohol.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Midland office at (432) 570-3390 or the Odessa office at (432) 335-9659.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de Midland al (432) 570-3390 o a la oficina de Odessa al (432) 335-9659.
records.cost: Charity care (free or discounted) available for those unable to pay; ask about fees
records.notes: Odessa substance use office: 1012 W Macarthur, Odessa, TX 79763, (432) 335-9659. Program types (outpatient/residential) not listed on the locations page; call to ask.

records.name: PermiaCare Early Childhood Intervention (ECI)
records.description_en: Help for babies and toddlers with developmental delays or disabilities, with offices in Midland and Odessa.
records.description_es: Ayuda para bebés y niños pequeños con retrasos en su desarrollo o con discapacidades, con oficinas en Midland y Odessa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in Midland and Ector counties with young children who may have delays or disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias en los condados de Midland y Ector con niños pequeños que pueden tener retrasos o discapacidades.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Midland ECI office at (432) 570-3366 or the Odessa ECI office at (432) 334-0900.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de ECI en Midland al (432) 570-3366 o a la oficina de ECI en Odessa al (432) 334-0900.
records.notes: Odessa ECI office: 2626 JBS Parkway, Suite 101A, Odessa, TX 79761, (432) 334-0900. Age limits not stated on source page (ECI is generally birth to 3 statewide).

records.name: Betty Hardwick Center Crisis Line
records.description_en: A 24-hour phone line for mental health crisis support, information, and referrals. Betty Hardwick Center is the local mental health authority for Taylor County and nearby counties.
records.description_es: Una línea telefónica abierta las 24 horas para apoyo en crisis de salud mental, información y referidos. Betty Hardwick Center es la autoridad local de salud mental para el condado de Taylor y condados cercanos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Taylor, Callahan, Jones, Shackelford, or Stephens counties who is in a mental health crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en los condados de Taylor, Callahan, Jones, Shackelford o Stephens que esté en una crisis de salud mental.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis line.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora.
records.notes: Homepage lists '24-Hour Crisis Hot Line: (800) 758-3344'; adult services page says the hotline is staffed by trained mental health professionals 24 hours a day. For medical emergencies call 911; 988 is also available.

records.name: Betty Hardwick Center Adult Mental Health Services
records.description_en: Ongoing mental health treatment for adults with serious mental illness, with walk-in intake in Abilene.
records.description_es: Tratamiento continuo de salud mental para adultos con enfermedades mentales graves. Puede llegar sin cita para la admisión en Abilene.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults who fit the state's priority group, usually people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or major depression.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos que forman parte del grupo prioritario del estado, por lo general personas con esquizofrenia, trastorno bipolar o depresión mayor.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in for intake Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-3:30 p.m., or complete the intake packet and email it to MHIntake@bettyhardwick.org or fax it to (325) 690-5187.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llegue sin cita para la admisión de lunes a viernes de 8 a.m. a 3:30 p.m., o llene el paquete de admisión y envíelo por correo electrónico a MHIntake@bettyhardwick.org o por fax al (325) 690-5187.
records.notes: Homepage lists 2616 South Clack, Abilene 79606; the child services page lists 2626 S Clack St - confirm by phone. Admissions screener: 1-800-758-3344. min_age 18 inferred from 'adult' program. Serves Callahan, Jones, Shackelford, Stephens, and Taylor counties.

records.name: Betty Hardwick Center Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services
records.description_en: Mental health treatment for children and teens with serious emotional or behavioral problems.
records.description_es: Tratamiento de salud mental para niños y adolescentes con problemas emocionales o de conducta serios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children ages 3 through 17 with a mental illness diagnosis and serious emotional, behavioral, or mental disorders that cause major problems at home, school, or in the community.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños de 3 a 17 años con un diagnóstico de enfermedad mental y problemas emocionales, de conducta o mentales serios que causan grandes dificultades en casa, en la escuela o en la comunidad.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in for intake Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-3:30 p.m., or email forms to MHIntake@bettyhardwick.org or fax to (325) 690-5187.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llegue sin cita para la admisión de lunes a viernes de 8 a.m. a 3:30 p.m., o envíe los formularios por correo electrónico a MHIntake@bettyhardwick.org o por fax al (325) 690-5187.
records.notes: Toll-free (800) 758-3344. Child services page lists the address as 2626 S Clack St (homepage says 2616 South Clack) - confirm by phone. Breckenridge location: 1612 W Walker St #200, (254) 522-3490.

records.name: MHMR Concho Valley Crisis Hotline and Mobile Crisis Outreach
records.organization: MHMR Services for the Concho Valley
records.description_en: A 24/7 crisis hotline staffed by trained mental health workers, plus a mobile crisis team that can come to homes, schools, and ERs.
records.description_es: Una línea de crisis abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días, atendida por trabajadores de salud mental capacitados, y un equipo móvil que puede ir a casas, escuelas y salas de emergencia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Tom Green County and nearby Concho Valley counties who is in a mental health crisis.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en el condado de Tom Green y condados cercanos del Concho Valley que esté en una crisis de salud mental.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis hotline any time.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora.
records.notes: Local crisis number also (325) 653-5933. Services include a 12-bed voluntary Crisis Respite Unit and Mental Health Deputies. Source names Tom Green, Reagan, Sterling, Concho, Coke, and Crockett counties and refers to 7 counties total.

records.name: MHMR Concho Valley Behavioral Health Services
records.organization: MHMR Services for the Concho Valley
records.description_en: Mental health, substance use, youth, veteran, supportive housing, and job help services in San Angelo.
records.description_es: Servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias, jóvenes, veteranos, vivienda con apoyo y ayuda para conseguir empleo en San Angelo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in the Concho Valley region, including Tom Green County, who need mental health or substance use care.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en la región del Concho Valley, incluido el condado de Tom Green, que necesitan atención de salud mental o por uso de sustancias.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main office to ask about services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina principal para preguntar por los servicios.
records.notes: Toll-free (833) 406-0857. Programs listed: Behavioral Health, IDD, Veteran Services, San Angelo Clubhouse, Youth Empowerment Services (YES), Suicide Prevention, Supportive Housing, Employment Assistance, Substance Use, Justice System Services, Mental Health First Aid. Counties served not listed on homepage.

records.organization: Permian Basin Workforce Development Board (Workforce Solutions Permian Basin)
records.description_en: Free help finding a job, exploring careers, getting training, and learning about unemployment benefits.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, explorar carreras, recibir capacitación y conocer los beneficios de desempleo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in the Permian Basin, including Midland County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo en la Cuenca Pérmica, incluido el condado de Midland.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Midland center or call to get started.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de Midland o llame para empezar.
records.address: 3600 N. Garfield, Midland College Technology Center, Room 138
records.notes: Hours not listed on website; call first. Toll-free 1-800-248-6451.

records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo en la Cuenca Pérmica, incluido el condado de Ector.

records.name: Child Care Services (Permian Basin)
records.description_en: Helps pay for child care so parents can work, go to school, or attend job training.
records.description_es: Ayuda para pagar el cuidado de niños para que los padres puedan trabajar, estudiar o recibir capacitación para el trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Permian Basin families with children under 13 (or under 19 with a disability) where parents work or attend school/training at least 25 hours a week (50 combined for two parents). Income limits apply, for example $49,610 a year for a family of 1 and $95,403 for a family of 4 (effective Oct. 1, 2026).
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de la Cuenca Pérmica con niños menores de 13 años (o menores de 19 si tienen una discapacidad), donde los padres trabajan o estudian al menos 25 horas por semana (50 horas entre los dos si son dos padres). Hay límites de ingresos, por ejemplo $49,610 al año para una familia de 1 y $95,403 para una familia de 4 (desde el 1 de octubre de 2026).
records.how_to_apply: Create an account and apply online at childcare.texas.gov. Call Child Care Services to check your waitlist status.
records.how_to_apply_es: Cree una cuenta y presente su solicitud en línea en childcare.texas.gov. Llame a Servicios de Cuidado Infantil para saber su lugar en la lista de espera.
records.cost: Parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Waitlist in effect since July 7, 2026; waits may be 3 to 6 months.

records.name: Workforce Solutions of the Concho Valley - San Angelo Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of the Concho Valley
records.description_en: Free job search help, resumes, skills tests, GED and adult education, training aid, and veteran services.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, hacer su currículum, pruebas de habilidades, GED y educación para adultos, ayuda para capacitación y servicios para veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in the 13-county Concho Valley region, including Tom Green County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo en los 13 condados del Concho Valley, incluido el condado de Tom Green.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the San Angelo office or call to get started.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite la oficina de San Angelo o llame para empezar.
records.notes: Toll-free (800) 996-7589. Programs include WIOA adult/dislocated worker and youth, TANF and SNAP E&T, AARP program, veteran services.

records.name: Child Care Services (Concho Valley)
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of the Concho Valley
records.description_en: Child care scholarships that help families pay for care so they can work, look for work, or go to school or training.
records.description_es: Becas de cuidado infantil que ayudan a las familias a pagar el cuidado de sus hijos para poder trabajar, buscar trabajo, estudiar o capacitarse.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in Tom Green and other Concho Valley counties. A single parent must work, search for work, or be in school/training at least 25 hours a week (50 combined for two parents). Gross monthly income limits apply, for example $6,443 for a family of 3 and $7,670 for a family of 4.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias en Tom Green y otros condados del Concho Valley. Un padre o madre soltero debe trabajar, buscar trabajo o estudiar al menos 25 horas por semana (50 horas entre los dos si son dos padres). Hay límites de ingresos mensuales brutos, por ejemplo $6,443 para una familia de 3 y $7,670 para una familia de 4.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of a Workforce Solutions of the Concho Valley county (e.g., Tom Green)

records.how_to_apply: Apply online through childcare.texas.gov ("Apply for assistance") or call a child care specialist.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea en childcare.texas.gov ("Apply for assistance") o llame a un especialista de cuidado infantil.
records.cost: Parent share of cost based on income
records.notes: Waiting list in effect; waits may be 6 weeks or more. Toll-free (800) 996-7589. Child must be a U.S. citizen or legal immigrant; assets under $1 million.

records.organization: Workforce Solutions of West Central Texas
records.description_en: Free job search help, career tests, GED help, workshops, and money for training in over 40 programs.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, pruebas de carrera, ayuda con el GED, talleres y dinero para capacitación en más de 40 programas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers in the 19-county West Central Texas region, including Taylor County. Extra help for youth, veterans, people with disabilities, people on public assistance, and older workers.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo en los 19 condados de West Central Texas, incluido el condado de Taylor. Hay ayuda extra para jóvenes, veteranos, personas con discapacidades, personas que reciben asistencia pública y trabajadores mayores.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Abilene center or call to get started.
records.how_to_apply_es: Visite el centro de Abilene o llame para empezar.

records.name: Child Care Services (West Central Texas)
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of West Central Texas
records.description_en: Helps parents pay for child care while they work, go to school, or attend training.
records.description_es: Ayuda a los padres a pagar el cuidado de sus hijos mientras trabajan, estudian o reciben capacitación.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income working or training parents, families on public assistance or recently off TANF, teen parents, and families of children with disabilities in the West Central Texas region, including Taylor County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Padres de bajos ingresos que trabajan o se capacitan, familias que reciben asistencia pública o que dejaron TANF hace poco, padres adolescentes y familias de niños con discapacidades en la región de West Central Texas, incluido el condado de Taylor.
records.how_to_apply: Check the basic requirements, then complete the Application for Child Care Services through the state portal and work with staff to choose a provider.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise los requisitos básicos, luego llene la Solicitud de Servicios de Cuidado Infantil en el portal del estado y trabaje con el personal para elegir un proveedor.
records.notes: Income limits not stated on the page fetched; call for details. Toll-free (800) 457-5633; TTY 800-735-2989 / 711.

records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income residents of the organization's 114-county service area. Use the eligibility checker or call to see if you qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de bajos ingresos en los 114 condados que atiende la organización. Use la herramienta para ver si califica o llame para preguntar.

records.notes: Office toll-free (800) 926-5630. Intake line answered in English and Spanish with interpreters for other languages. Landlord-tenant line: (855) 548-8457. Office's exact county list not stated on locations page. Hours shown are for the Legal Aid Line; local office hours not listed.

records.name: West Texas Food Bank - Midland
records.description_en: Food bank that supplies over 100 partner pantries and mobile food distributions across 19 West Texas counties. Also offers senior food boxes and SNAP information.
records.description_es: Banco de comida que abastece a más de 100 despensas asociadas y repartos móviles de comida en 19 condados del oeste de Texas. También ofrece cajas de comida para personas mayores e información sobre SNAP (estampillas de comida).
records.eligibility_summary_en: People who need food in the food bank's 19-county area, including Midland County. Senior Box Program is for people 60 and older.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que necesitan comida en los 19 condados que atiende el banco de comida, incluido el condado de Midland. El Programa de Cajas para Mayores es para personas de 60 años o más.
records.how_to_apply: Check the partner agency list and monthly mobile distribution schedule on the website, call the Midland office, or dial 2-1-1 after hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise en el sitio web la lista de agencias asociadas y el calendario mensual de repartos móviles, llame a la oficina de Midland o marque 2-1-1 fuera del horario.
records.notes: As of January 1, 2026 the food bank ended in-house pantry distributions; send people to partner agencies and mobile distributions instead of the warehouse.

records.how_to_apply: Check the partner agency list and monthly mobile distribution schedule on the website, call the Odessa office, or dial 2-1-1 after hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise en el sitio web la lista de agencias asociadas y el calendario mensual de repartos móviles, llame a la oficina de Odessa o marque 2-1-1 fuera del horario.
records.notes: As of January 1, 2026 the food bank ended in-house pantry distributions.

records.name: Food Bank of West Central Texas Drive-Thru Pantry
records.organization: Food Bank of West Central Texas
records.description_en: A drive-thru food pantry at the food bank in Abilene, plus a list of pantries and meal sites in Taylor and nearby counties. Free SNAP application help is also available.
records.description_es: Una despensa de comida donde puede recoger sin bajarse del carro, en el banco de comida de Abilene, además de una lista de despensas y lugares de comidas en Taylor y condados cercanos. También hay ayuda gratis para solicitar SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in Taylor County and surrounding West Central Texas counties who need food. Eligibility rules not listed; call to ask.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en el condado de Taylor y condados cercanos de West Central Texas que necesitan comida. Las reglas para calificar no están publicadas; llame para preguntar.
records.how_to_apply: Drive through during a scheduled distribution, or use the Find Food page for other pantries. For SNAP help, email programs@fbwct.org or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pase en carro durante un reparto programado, o use la página Find Food para ver otras despensas. Para ayuda con SNAP, escriba a programs@fbwct.org o llame.
records.hours: 1st Thursday 9-10:30 AM; 2nd Saturday 9-10:30 AM; 3rd Monday 4:30-6 PM
records.notes: Certified Case Assistance Navigators help with SNAP applications (https://www.fbwct.org/find-help/snap-assistance). Programs also include Senior Distributions and Food 4 Kids.

records.name: Concho Valley Regional Food Bank
records.description_en: Regional food bank in San Angelo that connects people to partner food pantries, distributions, the Veggie Van, and weekend snack packs for kids.
records.description_es: Banco de comida regional en San Angelo que conecta a las personas con despensas asociadas, repartos, el Veggie Van y paquetes de meriendas de fin de semana para niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in San Angelo and the Concho Valley who need food. Each pantry sets its own rules, so call the pantry before you go.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en San Angelo y el Concho Valley que necesitan comida. Cada despensa tiene sus propias reglas, así que llame a la despensa antes de ir.
records.how_to_apply: Look up a nearby pantry on the food bank's pantry list, or call the food bank for help finding one.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque una despensa cercana en la lista del banco de comida, o llame al banco de comida para que le ayuden a encontrar una.
records.notes: Pantry listings document updated 9-1-2026 is on the food resources page.

records.name: CVCAA Utility Assistance (CEAP)
records.description_en: Helps pay electric, gas, and propane bills and teaches ways to save energy.
records.description_es: Ayuda a pagar las facturas de luz, gas y propano, y enseña maneras de ahorrar energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households in Tom Green and 10 other Concho Valley counties. 2026 income limit is $23,940 for 1 person and $32,460 for 2 people.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos en Tom Green y otros 10 condados del Concho Valley. El límite de ingresos para 2026 es $23,940 para 1 persona y $32,460 para 2 personas.

eligibility_rules.residency_required: Resident of Coke, Concho, Crockett, Irion, Kimble, Menard, Reagan, Schleicher, Sterling, Sutton, or Tom Green County

documents_needed: Complete application with all eligibility documents
records.how_to_apply: Turn in a complete application with all documents. Inside San Angelo, only 25 in-person applications are accepted per day during set windows; outside San Angelo, apply any time during business hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Entregue una solicitud completa con todos los documentos. Dentro de San Angelo solo se aceptan 25 solicitudes en persona al día, en horarios fijos; fuera de San Angelo puede presentar su solicitud en cualquier momento durante el horario de oficina.
records.notes: Processing takes 60-90 days before a pledge is made to the account. Toll-free 1-877-41-CVCAA. Runnels, McCulloch, and Coleman county residents should contact Cornerstone Community Action Agency. Forms page: https://www.cvcaa.org/what_we_do/forms.php

records.name: CVCAA Homeless Services - Navigation Day
records.description_en: A monthly event where more than 20 agencies help people experiencing homelessness with ID documents, benefits sign-up, clothing, hygiene items, haircuts, and job and housing connections.
records.description_es: Un evento cada mes donde más de 20 agencias ayudan a personas sin hogar con documentos de identidad, inscripción en beneficios, ropa, artículos de higiene, cortes de pelo y conexiones con trabajo y vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People experiencing homelessness or housing problems in San Angelo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas sin hogar o con problemas de vivienda en San Angelo.
records.how_to_apply: Come to Navigation Day on the last Tuesday of each month, 9 a.m.-3 p.m., at First Presbyterian Church, 32 N. Irving St., San Angelo. Call CVCAA for other housing help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Venga al Navigation Day el último martes de cada mes, de 9 a.m. a 3 p.m., en la Iglesia First Presbyterian, 32 N. Irving St., San Angelo. Llame a CVCAA para otra ayuda de vivienda.
records.hours: Last Tuesday of each month, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
records.notes: CVCAA also offers housing assistance, veterans assistance, and free tax help (main office 133 W Concho Ave Suite 301).

records.name: Presbyterian Medical Care Mission
records.description_en: A charity clinic in Abilene giving primary medical care, low-cost prescriptions, diabetes education, nutrition counseling, and some specialist care to uninsured adults.
records.description_es: Una clínica de caridad en Abilene que da atención médica primaria, medicinas a bajo costo, educación sobre diabetes, consejería de nutrición y algo de atención con especialistas a adultos sin seguro.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income, uninsured adults ages 18 to 64. People with private insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid do not qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 18 a 64 años, de bajos ingresos y sin seguro médico. Las personas con seguro privado, Medicare o Medicaid no califican.
records.how_to_apply: Call the clinic to ask about becoming a patient.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la clínica para preguntar cómo hacerse paciente.
records.cost: Low cost; medications for a nominal fee
records.notes: Faith-based ministry. Income limit not stated on the page fetched.

records.name: Midland Health Financial Assistance / Midland County Hospital District Assistance
records.description_en: Free help to see if you qualify for Midland County Hospital District Assistance, hospital charity care, Medicaid, or disability benefits.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para ver si califica para la Asistencia del Distrito Hospitalario del Condado de Midland, el cuidado de caridad del hospital, Medicaid o beneficios por discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Patients who cannot afford care at Midland Health. You must show who lives in your home, that you live in the area, and your income.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Pacientes que no pueden pagar su atención en Midland Health. Debe mostrar quién vive en su casa, que vive en la zona y cuánto gana.
records.how_to_apply: Meet in person with the Financial Eligibility Office. For planned procedures, contact the office before your visit for a financial screening.
records.how_to_apply_es: Reúnase en persona con la Oficina de Elegibilidad Financiera. Si tiene un procedimiento programado, comuníquese con la oficina antes de su cita para una revisión financiera.
records.notes: Acts as the county indigent/hospital district assistance door for Midland County. Income limits (FPL %) not listed; call. Applications available in English and Spanish on the website. Additional documents may be requested.

records.name: Medical Center Health System Financial Assistance (Ector County Hospital District)
records.description_en: Financial help for low-income Ector County residents with hospital bills, prescriptions, some outpatient procedures, and doctor visits.
records.description_es: Ayuda económica para personas de bajos ingresos con facturas del hospital, medicinas, algunos procedimientos ambulatorios y visitas al médico.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income (indigent) patients through the Ector County Hospital District Assistance Program. Exact income and residency rules are not posted; call and ask for the Business Office.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Pacientes de bajos ingresos a través del Programa de Asistencia del Distrito Hospitalario del Condado de Ector. Las reglas exactas de ingresos y residencia no están publicadas; llame y pida hablar con la Oficina de Negocios (Business Office).
records.how_to_apply: Contact the Business Office at Medical Center Health System. Counselors can also help you apply for county, state, or federal programs.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con la Oficina de Negocios de Medical Center Health System. Los consejeros también pueden ayudarle a solicitar programas del condado, del estado o federales.
records.notes: Phone is the main hospital number; ask for the Business Office / financial assistance. Three HHSC benefit counselors have offices on the hospital campus. Residency rules not stated on source.

records.name: Midland Health Services (City of Midland)
records.description_en: City public health clinic offering shots, STD/HIV testing and treatment, and TB testing.
records.description_es: Clínica de salud pública de la ciudad que ofrece vacunas, pruebas y tratamiento de ETS/VIH y pruebas de tuberculosis.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Midland residents and visitors who need public health services.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes y visitantes de Midland que necesitan servicios de salud pública.
records.how_to_apply: Call for an appointment and press 3 when prompted. All services are by appointment only.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita y oprima el 3 cuando se lo pidan. Todos los servicios son solo con cita.
records.notes: Email: MidlandHealth@MidlandTexas.gov. WIC is not offered here per page.

records.name: Ector County Health Department
records.description_en: County health clinic offering shots, STD/HIV testing, TB testing, Pap smear clinics, and free cervical cancer screening for those who qualify.
records.description_es: Clínica de salud del condado que ofrece vacunas, pruebas de ETS/VIH, pruebas de tuberculosis, clínicas de Papanicolaou y detección gratis de cáncer de cuello uterino para quienes califican.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Ector County residents. Some services, like Pap smear clinics and free cervical cancer screening, require you to qualify.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del condado de Ector. Algunos servicios, como las clínicas de Papanicolaou y la detección gratis de cáncer de cuello uterino, requieren que usted califique.
records.how_to_apply: Call to book shots (appointment only). STD/HIV and TB testing accept walk-ins during set times.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame para hacer una cita para vacunas (solo con cita). Para pruebas de ETS/VIH y de tuberculosis puede llegar sin cita en los horarios indicados.
records.hours: Closed for lunch 12 pm to 1 pm. STD/HIV walk-in: Tue 1-3:30 pm, Wed 8:30-10:30 am. TB testing: Mon and Tue 8:30-11 am and 1-4 pm. Pap clinic: Thu 1-3 pm.
records.cost: Vaccine admin fee $13 for one shot, $26 for two or more (per child); cervical cancer screening free for eligible people
records.notes: Private vaccines also available: Hepatitis B $50, Tdap $55. For cervical cancer screening details call (432) 498-4141 ext. 0.

records.name: San Angelo Health Services
records.description_en: City public health department with nursing services for San Angelo residents.
records.description_es: Departamento de salud pública de la ciudad con servicios de enfermería para residentes de San Angelo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: San Angelo residents.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de San Angelo.
records.how_to_apply: Call Health Services or the nursing line to ask about services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Health Services o a la línea de enfermería para preguntar por los servicios.
records.notes: Confirmed only via city staff directory; services, clinic address, and hours not confirmed. Nursing line: (325) 657-4214.

records.name: San Angelo WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition advice, and breastfeeding help to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da alimentos saludables, consejos de nutrición y ayuda con la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás que acaban de dar a luz, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant or postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet WIC income rules. Call the local WIC office to check.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas o que dieron a luz hace poco, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen con las reglas de ingresos de WIC. Llame a la oficina local de WIC para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call the San Angelo WIC office to set up an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la oficina de WIC de San Angelo para hacer una cita.
records.notes: Confirmed via city staff directory (Women, Infants & Children listing). Clinic address and hours not confirmed.

records.name: Abilene Public Health (City of Abilene)
records.description_en: The City of Abilene's public health department. Call to ask what health services are offered.
records.description_es: El departamento de salud pública de la Ciudad de Abilene. Llame para preguntar qué servicios de salud ofrecen.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Abilene residents. Call to ask about services and who can use them.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de Abilene. Llame para preguntar por los servicios y quién puede usarlos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Public Health main number to ask about services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal de Salud Pública para preguntar por los servicios.
records.notes: Confirmed only via city staff directory; clinic services, address, and hours not confirmed.

records.name: Abilene WIC Clinic
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition advice, and breastfeeding help to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: WIC da alimentos saludables, consejos de nutrición y ayuda con la lactancia a mujeres embarazadas, mamás que acaban de dar a luz, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant or postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet WIC income rules. Call the WIC clinic to check.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas o que dieron a luz hace poco, bebés y niños menores de 5 años que cumplen con las reglas de ingresos de WIC. Llame a la clínica de WIC para saber si califica.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email the Abilene WIC clinic (wic@abilenetx.gov) to set up an appointment.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o escriba a la clínica de WIC de Abilene (wic@abilenetx.gov) para hacer una cita.
records.notes: Clinic phone and email (wic@abilenetx.gov) from the city staff directory; WIC Program Manager line is (325) 437-4646. Clinic address and hours not confirmed.

records.name: Noah Project
records.description_en: Free and confidential shelter, outreach, and support for survivors of domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, and human trafficking.
records.description_es: Refugio, apoyo y ayuda gratis y confidencial para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica, violencia en el noviazgo, agresión sexual y trata de personas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Women, men, their children, and unaccompanied youth who have faced family violence, dating violence, sexual assault, or human trafficking in the ten West Texas counties Noah Project serves, including the Abilene area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres, hombres, sus hijos y jóvenes solos que han sufrido violencia familiar, violencia en el noviazgo, agresión sexual o trata de personas en los diez condados del oeste de Texas que atiende Noah Project, incluida la zona de Abilene.
records.how_to_apply: Call the crisis hotline or email crisishelp@noahproject.org.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de crisis o escriba a crisishelp@noahproject.org.
records.notes: Local hotline (325) 676-7107. Exact list of the 10 counties not on the page fetched; Taylor assumed from Abilene location.

records.name: EZ-Rider Public Transit and Paratransit
records.description_en: City bus and paratransit service in Midland and Odessa, with half fares for seniors, people with disabilities, and veterans.
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús y paratránsito en Midland y Odessa, con media tarifa para personas mayores, personas con discapacidades y veteranos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride. Seniors 60+ and people with disabilities pay $0.60 with a Medicare card; veterans and active military pay $0.60 with ID; children 5 and under ride free.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona puede viajar. Las personas de 60 años o más y las personas con discapacidades pagan $0.60 con su tarjeta de Medicare; los veteranos y militares activos pagan $0.60 con identificación; los niños de 5 años o menos viajan gratis.
documents_needed: Military or veteran ID (veteran reduced fare)
records.how_to_apply: Show your ID when paying. Buy passes at H-E-B Business Centers, Midland College Student Union, the EZ-Rider Administration Building, or the Odessa College Information Desk.
records.how_to_apply_es: Muestre su identificación al pagar. Compre pases en los Business Centers de H-E-B, en el Student Union de Midland College, en el edificio de administración de EZ-Rider o en el mostrador de información de Odessa College.

records.name: CityLink Transit
records.description_en: Abilene city bus service plus door-to-door ADA paratransit for people who cannot use regular buses.
records.description_es: Servicio de autobús de la ciudad de Abilene, más paratránsito de puerta a puerta (ADA) para personas que no pueden usar los autobuses regulares.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone can ride fixed routes. Paratransit is for riders who qualify under the ADA.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona puede usar las rutas fijas. El paratránsito es para personas que califican bajo la ley ADA.
records.how_to_apply: Call fixed-route or paratransit lines, or book paratransit through the CityLink Transit app.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de rutas fijas o de paratránsito, o reserve el paratránsito con la aplicación CityLink Transit.
records.hours: Office: Monday-Friday 6 am to 6 pm; Saturday 7 am to 6 pm. Service Monday-Saturday; no Sunday or major holiday service.
records.notes: Paratransit: (325) 676-6287. Texas Relay 711. A fare increase begins October 1, 2026; reduced fare rules not listed on page - call CityLink.

records.name: Concho Valley Transit District
records.description_en: Public bus and transit service in San Angelo and the Concho Valley.
records.description_es: Servicio público de autobús y transporte en San Angelo y el Concho Valley.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Reduced fare rules are not listed online; call to ask.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto al público. Las reglas de tarifa reducida no están publicadas en línea; llame para preguntar.
records.how_to_apply: Call Concho Valley Transit for routes, fares, and reduced fare information.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Concho Valley Transit para saber de rutas, tarifas y tarifas reducidas.
